verdict.rationale: Missive has building blocks that could approximate focused streams: team inboxes and dedicated team spaces give a team stream, up to 1000 automation rules and labels can sort mail, and an agent can triage new conversations before you look at them. None of the evidence shows a dedicated split-inbox or priority-stream view, so the power user would have to assemble this from rules and labels. Missing for 10: a documented split-inbox or stream feature, automatic categories for important, newsletters and calendar invites, priority-ordered triage views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
